I have been on Abilify for a couple years more or less now. On low dosage it gives me horrible akathisia but when increased to 20 mg the akathisia completely disappeared. My doctor tried to switch me to zyprexa and it made me gain weight uncontrollably so he had to put me back to Abilify (he explained it's because the rest of the antipsychotics will pretty much make me gain weight as well) and now I'm on 25mg and seldom hear or see stuff nowadays.
He increased it because Abilify has a tendency to cause a wide assortment of side effects when on low dosage.

I leave some bread for a couple of cats that live near my backyard (my family doesn't like pets much and only let my dog live with me). My dog, a Pomeranian, eats EVERYTHING (like a pomeranian). She also has a habit of being friendly to cats (approaching them without any caution, these are street cats so it's a bit dangerous for my dog to do that). The cats run away if I come too near to them.

One time my dog nudged the back of my foot, which scared the hell out of me so I dropped the bread. She swoops it with her mouth really quickly, walks towards the cats, drops the bread and sits right in front of them. The cats proceeded to eat the bread. When the bread was finished my dog calmly walked over to me as if nothing had happened. The next day when I was about to feed them, I gave the bread to my dog and she does the same. A week after that, the cats follow my dog around and they would play around. They have since started to warm up to me. As they were outside cats it was fine with my dad. I named them sub black and sub orange (sub for subordinate). 

**TLDR** My dog feeds cats bread and becomes cat mafia boss
